easyPrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature and have a creature card in your graveyard which have a collective mana value of 6 or less.
description:
Activate Yurlok by paying {1} and tapping it, causing each player to add {B}{R}{G}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}. When it enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying an amount of {E}, sacrificing an additional nontoken creature, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When the creature dies, Yurlok triggers, untapping Yurlok.
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare trigger, returning another creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
